name: Пустой костюм
alt: Пустой деловой костюм шагает сам по себе, а галстук изображает язык.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated colors, simple chunky forms, strong readable silhouette, minimal scenery, one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: An EMPTY plum-purple business suit walking by itself as a dungeon monster: floating jacket, empty cuffs, trousers and exactly two brown shoes; visibly no head, no hands, no person inside. White shirt collar surrounds an empty dark neck hole. Red tie sticks outward like a cheeky tongue. One sleeve raised threateningly, other on hip, little spilled coins underfoot. Entire suit visible.
